chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (Allah) (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about a man who entered into Umrah and forgot to shorten (his hair, nails, etc.) until he entered into Hajj. He said: He should seek forgiveness of Allah, and there is nothing upon him, and his Umrah is complete.

key_terms.لَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: Nothing is upon him (no penalty/damages due)
key_terms.يُقَصِّرَ: To shorten (hair, nails, etc., as part of the ritual completion of Umrah)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pilgrim forgets to cut their hair before entering Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that forgetting to shorten hair or nails (Qasr) during Umrah before entering Hajj does not invalidate the ritual, requiring only repentance (Istighfar) rather than a compensatory sacrifice (Hady). This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle of distinguishing between minor omissions that do not break the state of Ihram and major prohibitions, emphasizing divine mercy in cases of unintentional error. The hadith serves as a key reference for understanding the flexibility in Hajj rituals when forgetfulness is involved, contrasting with stricter interpretations found in other schools of thought.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who began with the Umra and forgot that he should be shortening (hair, nails etc.) until he entered into the Hajj. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should seek Forgiveness of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and there is nothing upon him, and he should complete his Umra’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about a man who commences al-‘Umrah but then forgets Taqsir (cutting some hair or finger nails and so on) until he enters al-Hajj. He (the Imam) said, ‘He must ask forgiveness from Allah. He is not obligated for anything in this matter. His al-‘Umrah is complete.’”
